subject: Boolean literals
notes: 'The separators that delimit the boolean literal are not included in the value of the boolean literal' (cite.py --check 8.3.3.4.4 GR1 OK). SplitLiteral strips the B/BX prefix and the delimiters; Decode returns only the body. Probe bl1: DISPLAY B"0101" -> 0101, B'10' -> 10; FUNCTION LENGTH(B"0101")=4. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 2002, 2014, 2023 (boolean literals are a COBOL-2002 introduction, gated COBOL0900 at --std 85 - probe bl7; the zero-length-literal introduction edge is not derivable from the in-repo 2023 text, whose Annex E lists only the 2014->2023 delta)
